multi_entity_note: Contract between EuroTel Bratislava a.s. (customer) and Sicap Ltd (supplier), with two addresses and references to the original Swisscom contract.
processing_note: Maintenance and Support fees are payable       semi-annually in advance.

contract.document_name.rationale: The cover page titles the document "Maintenance and support contract for SICAP(R) modules PPB, VCA and OTA" and the body refers to itself as "this Maintenance and Support contract"; the "M&S contract" running headers are abbreviations.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The cover states the contract is "dated 10 October 2000"; 06 April 1998 is the original purchase contract and 06 October 2000 is the effective date.

contract.effective_date.rationale: Clause 7.5 states "It shall be effective on 06 October 2000"; 06 April 1998 is the effective date of the separate original Swisscom contract.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The initial term is stated only as a duration of two years from 06 October 2000; no expiry date is written.

contract.governing_law.rationale: The contract has no governing-law clause; Slovakia and Switzerland appear only in addresses, holidays and VAT.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: Clause 7.5: after the initial two years the contract is automatically renewed for a period of one year on each renewal date.

contract.notice_period.rationale: Clause 7.5 requires termination notice by registered letter at least six (6) weeks prior to the renewal date.
